meta.summary: NVIDIA's SkillEvaluator asks three separate questions about an agent skill, and the first one needs no model at all.
meta.note: Backfilled on 2026-11-27: the run on this date could not reach the site. Picks, fit and verdicts are the run's own; stars, licence and last activity were read from GitHub on 2026-11-27.

picks.what: A command-line tool and CI template that checks agent skills in three tiers: static checks with no model key, overlap detection, and live agent runs with and without the skill.
picks.area: Agent skills, playbooks and their evaluation
picks.fitWhy: Its first tier is deterministic and keyless, which is how I want skill checks to work, and it targets the exact thing I build: skills that must load and fire.
picks.caution: Its own docs call it experimental with no support guarantee. The live tier sends work to a hosted model provider and can cost money.

picks.what: A security scanner for agent skills that looks for malicious patterns, prompt injection, data exfiltration and supply-chain risks before you install them.
picks.area: Agent skills, playbooks and their evaluation
picks.fitWhy: I treat every installable skill as code to review, and this automates the first pass of that review.
picks.caution: Check what its dependency checks send to outside services before running it on private skills. Stars measure attention, not quality.

picks.what: A registry for agents and skills with lifecycle states and signed, logged publication.
picks.area: Agent skills, playbooks and their evaluation
picks.fitWhy: Lifecycle states for skills are worth reading, though a server-based registry is more than a solo setup needs.

picks.what: A benchmark of tasks that measures whether skills actually help agents.
picks.area: Agent skills, playbooks and their evaluation
picks.fitWhy: Its task folders show what a checkable outcome for a skill can look like.

picks.what: A tool that profiles an app and ports only its hot functions to Rust, checked against recorded calls.
picks.fitWhy: The same shape as rust-anything, a few days younger.
picks.caution: Very young, with fast star growth. Stars measure attention, not quality.

picks.what: Design skills that write a design brief and review screens against a design system.
picks.area: Static-site and design tooling for an Astro site
picks.fitWhy: Design review against a system is close to my site work, but the review is prompt-driven.
picks.caution: GitHub reports no recognised licence (NOASSERTION). Installable skill: review before use.

picks.what: Claude Code agents that test apps on phone simulators in CI.
picks.fitWhy: Interesting, but I do not build mobile apps.
